DA meltdown

By: Liz Fish | Production

Proposal


Show:

One Liner (Tonight on Carte Blanche...):
The longest serving mayor of Cape Town faces the axe

Unique Selling Point:
Mayor De Lille is still in office for now but the DA has two major investigations running against her while Cape Town faces its worse water crisis in its history.Mayor Patricia De Lille was severely chastised by the DA this week for having brought the party into disrepute and not handling the drought crisis in the best manner. There are several charges against her but no corruption charges which has been her biggest challenge to the DA and the public to date. She remains in office for now and the DA Federal Legal Commission has 60 days to investigate. The City Council will take a decision on Tuesday to possibly remove her from the Drought crisis in order to handle the legal process against her

Summary:
The story will summarise the crisis De Lille and the City has faced over the last 4 months and the two investigations. The second and parallel investigation is based on the Bowman Gilfillan report which is within the City of Cape Town.
The focus of the insert will be what impact this very public spat has had on the DA and the running of Cape Town. How both De Lille and the DA have handled the process. De Lille has attacked the DA and DA is charging her with bringing the party into disrepute and criticising her leadership style- the aggregating of power around the mayor’s office at the expense of running the City by interfering with senior management.
The second element will be how the DA has an opportunity to run 4 major metropolis namely Cape Town, JHB , Nelson Mandela Bay and Tshwane - how well are they doing? All have been wracked with similar leadership struggles and infighting. What impact will this have in the 2019 elections? The fallout in Nelson Mandela Bay between Trollip and UDM deputy mayor Mongameli Bobani ? JHB’ s Mayor Herman Mashaba and the vote of no-confidence in him at the end of last year?



Further information:
The City of Cape Town has fared the best of all the DA Metropoles but De Lille leadership style and the infighting within the party has been unravelling over the last 4 months during the worse crisis Cape Town has ever faced. National Government has left Cape Town in the lurch to handle the water crisis which they have a major responsibility for as it is required to provide adequate water through catchment areas and water licences. A special council meeting on Tuesday will see De Lille hand over to the water crisis management to Deputy Mayor and Xanthea Limberg and leave the city engineers to handle the water crisis. De Lille removed powers from the former and took it on as her personal campaign

Press Release:


DA Future
As the governing party, the ANC is experiencing resurgence under the new leadership of Cyril Ramaphosa, trouble is brewing in the opposition camps of the Democratic Alliance. From Cape Town, to Port Elizabeth, to Johannesburg, major internal power struggles plague the DA. Can the official opposition survive the political fallout in the Western Cape and its key metropoles throughout the country? Carte Blanche analyses a party, seemingly in disarray.


Script:


Script: Capetonians woke on Monday morning to the news that there was less than 100 days left of water, the City Manager had resigned under a cloud of allegations, and their mayor was charged with dereliction of her duties and mismanagement
Link: The 2016 local Government elections were a political slam dunk for the Democratic Alliance Tswhane Johannesburg and Nelson Mandela Bay brought to 4 the number of major metropole’s now under their control but just over a year later their confidence has taken a significant knock with the possible exception of Tshwane their electoral strong hold are now mired in controversy
Script: Cape Town is the DA’s flagship city with the largest caucus of 150 DA councillors – but they have been at each other’s throats for the last 5 months. It erupted in September last year when a row between Mayor De Lille and MAYCO member for safety and security JP Smith hit the headlines. De Lille had to all intents and purposes neutralised the Special Investigating Unit under JP Smith. This spurred an investigation headed up by Chief Whip John Steenhusien.
LINKS “Patricia De Lille is being investigated on two fronts the parties Federal executive legal commission is pursuing charges against her on the basis on what is now known as the Steenhuisen report
Script: The major charge is centralising power in her office and bloating her mayoral staff, belittling and bulling City officials and the DA caucus which has cost the city experienced and skilled professionals. The more serious charges are management irregularities
• The appointment of Limia Essop a close family friend to the Stadium Management Board
• R9 million payment to the V&A
• Neuralising The Special Investigative Unit
• Unwarranted interference in appointment process of City Manager by sending this Whatsapp
• “I want to keep Achmat so score him highest. Thanks”

Link: “These allegations stem from a document known as the Steenhuisen report the conclusion to which is astonishingly frank and damming it says the instability in the City of Cape Town poses a clear and present danger to our electoral prospects in 2019. And unless the party takes decisive action to reverse the current situation we face the very real prospect of losing significant votes in the next election.
Script: And on Sunday it came to a head when she was officially charged by the DA Federal Executive
Mmnusi- Press Conference “On the basis of extensive evidence before them (including the Mayor’s own representations), prima facie constituted gross misconduct, gross dereliction of duty, and conduct that amounted to deceiving Council.”
Script: De Lille said she was glad she was now officially charged and that the corruption charges have been dropped
Link “How the mayor deals with concerns raised by members of her own caucus when it comes to the actual running of the City is also under the spot light it’s the subject of an independent parallel investigation being led by the law firm Bowman Gilfillan.
Script: These allegations relate to her cover-up of significant financial losses in the My Citi bus system and alleged misconduct by the now suspended transport commissioner Melissa Whitehead, amongst numerous other charges. After committing to an interview with Carte Blanche, De Lille pulled out at the 11th hour citing that the legal process was now underway. We put some of the issues raging in the public to DA Leader Mmusi Maimane
John “There are two parallel process why not one and why don’t they overlap
Mmusi “ Firstly as a party we separate party and state …..and 2ndly there are certain aspects of investigations that are of a forensic nature which a council or a legislative body needs to be able to deal with and there are other aspects that are political that you need to give due consideration to
Script: De Lille says in her 200 page reply to the Fed Exc that she was already found guilty and refutes most of the report. She now has an opportunity to defend herself. The ANC have already called for a no confidence debate and DA members can vote with their conscience
John “ I would like to dwell on some of the issues feeding into the public sympathy, one is that Patricia De Lille is being targeted by a group of middle aged white bully boys who are acting behind the scenes pulling the strings
Mmusi “ I think it is an unfair allegation against a fairly reputable firm in Bowman and Gilfillian. We wanted a reputable firm to do its work so that we can strip away all of the misinformation that says it’s because of race or gender or whatever the issue is
Script; Political analyst Sanusha Naidu says no matter what the process , the voters see it differently
Sanusha “What we have to think about is why would you do this now is there and overriding concern to reign in De Lille to make sure you have control at the FEDEXEC level so that you don’t have a mayor that runs away and becomes much more popular than the party and at what cost are you going to do it- my bottom line is the DA and De Lille are going to be casualties of this whole affair
Script: De Lille sees this as a witch hunt to get rid of her replacing her with newly elected provincial leader Bonginkosi Madikizela which would serve their agenda in the 2019 elections
MM “ Far from, when someone is charged with serious issues they must be investigated
Sanusha 18 02 36 22 it is going to be difficult for them to justify this in any way possible she was the one who blew the whole whistle on the arms scandal, the corruption deal, she formed the ID. She will have a Coloured constituency backing they may see this as an attack on a Coloured women
John “Public perception certainly seems to rest with the mayor
MM “The are some serious allegations in the management of the stadium contract, the bus contract, the appointment of the City Manager. If you get into that type of reasoning and process then soon people will not be touchable because suddenly someone will say oh well person X or person Y will help us electorally and they are stronger therefore whatever wrong doing that they do no action must be taken against
Script: This political melt down could not have come at a worse time for the DA as the whole political landscape has shifted since the election of Cyril Ramaphose as the ANC president
Link: “ Jacob might been soon recalled as the countries president and opposition parties are repositioning themselves ahead of the Cyril Ramaphosa era
Script: Political analyst Richard Calland says Ramaphosa is not a scandal ridden as Jacob Zuma was and this will pose new challenges for the opposition
Richard “How do they create a new demon that they can demonise in order to gain electoral advantage in the run up to the 2019 election 16 08 19 00 there has been a scurry of activity in the last week or so in relation to the H an M advert …the EFF have seized on that kind of desperately as an opportunity to regain the spot light. … Their brand is one of militancy of action and of anti -establishment behaviour
John Do you think the DA has got it wrong in terms of how they have approached its coalition dynamics if you like
Richard “The DA suffers from a kind of Empirical arrogance to be perfectly honest it tends to think it always knows best .We have seen many skirmishes in PE the coalition there is somewhat precarious and as election approaches I think in Jhb and Tshwane it is really going to be put und pressure I fail to see making the DA look good in government is in the interests of Julius Malema and the EFF .
MM “When it comes to NMB we are dealing with Councilor Boyani the deputy mayor who if you read independently Crispan Olver’s book how to steal a city Councilor Boyani is complicit in many actions there . You have to in fact however difficult that bullet is you have got to take it and say in the interest of clean and transparent government you are going to act.
Script: This week Johannesburg Mayor Herman Mashaba fired the MMC for Finance Rabelani Dagada and laid criminal charges against him
MM “ If there are challenges with one of our own we don’t hesitate we take action- OUT
John “ In spite of the change of administration potholes are still there the billing crisis is still there how do you explain the disappointed that you sometimes hear
MM When we arrived in JHB we arrived and found ourselves in a space fiscally we are now investigating 16 billion rands worth of corruption by the previous administration. The infra structure back logue alone in Johannesburg is a R170 billion We inherited over 100 000 incorrect bills now we have reduced that to less than R20 000.
Link: “ The machinations in the city of Cape Town could not have come at a worse time for the democratic alliance the province is in the grip in one of the worse droughts in more than 100 years and in just in 100 days the taps in this city could run dry now the parties Federal Executive is trying to wrest control of the response to the drought from the mayor but De Lille is fighting back
Script: De Lille was at the drought update on Thursday despite being asked to step aside and focus on her defense and let MAYCO member Xanthea Limberg and the deputy mayor Ian Neilson to take over
John 17 32 34 221 Given you are facing this crisis the issues around governance and the mayors role in the cacus should have been postponed to be dealt with at another time
MMusi “ It is precisely why you want to get them out the way so that you can focus on the drought. WE have got some senior managers in the administration who need to work within a climate that is free of intimidation and any type of fear and need to be able to do their job and its precisely because of that.
Richard “ The Western Cape’s base and its based politically but also governmentally and it can’t be seen to be messing things up here ….
John Could this be do you think that a natural disaster influences the way people vote
Mmusi “ Water provision is a competence of National Government , cities only reticulate water they don’t build dams and we should ask Nomvula to come and account to the people of SA as to what actions she has put in mitigating this drought and be able to deal with a different water plan the City has done everything it can. What has National Government done.

De Lille has attacked the DA and DA is charging her with bringing the party into disrepute and criticising her leadership style- the aggregating of power around the mayor’s office at the expense of running the City by interfering with senior management. The second element will be how the DA has an opportunity to run 4 major metropolis namely Cape Town, JHB , Nelson Mandela Bay and Tshwane - how well are they doing? All have been wracked with similar leadership struggles and infighting. What impact will this have in the 2019 elections? The fallout in Nelson Mandela Bay between Trollip and UDM deputy mayor Mongameli Bobani ? JHB’ s Mayor Herman Mashaba and the vote of no-confidence in him at the end of last year?
metadata.Further information: The City of Cape Town has fared the best of all the DA Metropoles but De Lille leadership style and the infighting within the party has been unravelling over the last 4 months during the worse crisis Cape Town has ever faced. National Government has left Cape Town in the lurch to handle the water crisis which they have a major responsibility for as it is required to provide adequate water through catchment areas and water licences. A special council meeting on Tuesday will see De Lille hand over to the water crisis management to Deputy Mayor and Xanthea Limberg and leave the city engineers to handle the water crisis.
